title: Real multi-cell live MODFLOW6 application qualification
predecessors: F-GC45 real N:1 one-cell MultiSWAP application
goal: Qualify two independently transactional real FMR/SWAP interfaces coupled 1:1 to two distinct live MODFLOW6 cells in one model, one timestep and one prepared solve.
decisions: Keep each groundwater cell 1:1 with one real SWAP column; do not combine multi-cell and N:1 in the same first capability.
Use two API package slots and two distinct MODFLOW node ids through the admitted F-GC34 multi-slot publisher.
Each interface has its own SWAP lineage, coupling id, groundwater lineage and ledger identity while sharing one MODFLOW service/timestep.
Each SWAP corrector uses the head of its own MODFLOW cell and its own immutable accepted checkpoint.
Coupled convergence requires MODFLOW convergence and both cell-wise flux residuals within tolerance.
All SWAP and ledger preflights for both cells complete before the single MODFLOW finalize_time_step; then SWAP and ledger publication is deterministic by cell id.
next_permitted_action: F-GC46 is closed. Any combined multi-cell+N:1 topology or expansion of the prescribed-head/physics envelope is a separate bounded capability and is not implicitly admitted by F-GC46.
implemented: two-interface qualification-only Fortran bridge over admitted real FMR/SWAP production participants
F-GC40 single-tile-equivalent cell response per interface
F-GC34 two-slot/two-node live MODFLOW API mapping
two cell-specific real SWAP correctors in one prepared solve
two independent interface ledgers with all-interface preflight before publication
admission_criteria: exact-head live multi-cell owner qualification green
PR mergeable and scope remains two 1:1 cells without N:1 or physics expansion
admitted_capability: two independently transactional real FMR/SWAP interfaces coupled 1:1 to two distinct live MODFLOW6 6.8.0 cells
two F-GC34 API package slots mapped to distinct MODFLOW node ids inside one prepared solve
cell-specific real SWAP correctors from immutable accepted checkpoints
conjunctive MODFLOW plus two-cell interface-flux convergence
all-interface SWAP and ledger readiness before one irreversible MODFLOW timestep publication
single MODFLOW timestep publication followed by all SWAP commits and all ledger commits
per-cell committed ledger closure against accepted whole-window SWAP exchange

evidence_boundary.statement: Multi-cell runtime/composition qualification only; production source delta NONE.
evidence_boundary.topology: two 1:1 SWAP-to-MODFLOW interfaces in one groundwater model
not_claimed: heterogeneous spatial aggregation or equivalent-column science
active drainage, root uptake, macropores, snow or soil temperature
